product.olivetti-m4-40.summary: The 25 MHz SX M4 in the MicroTower chassis.
product.olivetti-m4-40.history: The M4 Modulo range targeted professionals and sat between the personal-use PCS and the higher-performance M6 Suprema. The guide identifies Scarmagno as the manufacturing site of the BA2034 board.
product.olivetti-m4-40.architecture: Memory can grow without replacing the base RAM. The board has 4 MB soldered down, one SIMM socket and CL-GD5428 graphics.
product.olivetti-m4-40.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-40.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-40.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 2
product.olivetti-m4-40.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 2.06.
